[[Darth Caedus]] constructed a '''red-bladed lightsaber''' to compensate for the loss of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Jacen Solo's lightsaber|first lightsaber]], [[Lightsaber/Legends|one]] that he had constructed in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]] while still a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Caedus wielded his [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] until his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[41 ABY]] where he used it in a [[Battle of Uroro Station|duel]] with his [[Twin/Legends|twin sister]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].
